captions.caption: Soldiers in desert camouflage stand near a large howitzer in a dusty field.
A soldier prepares an artillery shell on a wooden platform.
Close-up of large artillery shells with black and yellow markings.
A line of artillery shells sits ready in the foreground.
Soldiers move around the M777 howitzer to prepare for firing.
The camera shows a perspective of the shells lined up near the gun.
Military personnel are busy with various tasks around the artillery piece.
A soldier carries a long ramrod near the back of the gun.
Several soldiers coordinate to lift and position a heavy shell.
The crew works together to align the projectile with the breech.
A soldier holds the ramming pole, waiting for the shell to be placed.
The artillery shell is inserted into the breech of the howitzer.
Soldiers use the ramrod to push the shell firmly into the barrel.
The loading team applies force to seat the projectile.
The ramrod is removed from the barrel after the shell is seated.
Soldiers quickly clear the path behind the artillery piece.
A soldier prepares the propellant charge for the next step.
The propellant charge is placed into the breech behind the shell.
Crew members move to their designated safety positions.
A soldier closes the breech block of the howitzer.
Final adjustments are made to the gun's elevation and aim.
Soldiers brace themselves, covering their ears for the blast.
The firing lanyard is prepared by one of the gunners.
A soldier runs across the frame with the ramrod in hand.
The team stands ready, awaiting the final command to fire.
Close-up of soldiers monitoring the howitzer's instruments.
A soldier makes a fine adjustment to the gun's settings.
The crew remains focused and alert in the desert environment.
Communication occurs between the crew members to ensure readiness.
A soldier gives the verbal signal to prepare for firing.
The tension builds as the crew prepares for the shot.
The howitzer fires, emitting a large cloud of smoke and dust.
Dust kicks up from the ground due to the intense blast wave.
The gun recoils and then settles back into its original position.
Soldiers immediately move back toward the breech after the shot.
The breech is opened, and smoke drifts out of the barrel.
A different angle shows the howitzer firing from the front.
Fire and smoke burst from the muzzle brake during a shot.
The massive artillery piece jerks backward from the recoil.
Soldiers are seen working around the gun amidst the smoke.
The crew efficiently resets the weapon for the next round.
A soldier operates the manual controls on the side of the gun.
Dust and smoke continue to linger in the air around the crew.
The camera pans back to show the full crew in action.
Soldiers move with urgency to reload the howitzer.
A new artillery round is brought forward by a soldier.
The gun fires another round, causing a significant blast.
Thick smoke billows out from the front of the howitzer.
The loading process begins again with a new shell.
A soldier holds a green propellant charge ready for loading.
Crew members perform their roles with disciplined precision.
The breech is prepared for the next projectile to be loaded.
Soldiers shout instructions to coordinate the rapid fire.
A gunner checks the sights to ensure the target is locked.
The shell is lifted towards the breech by the loading team.
The ramrod is brought into position to push the shell in.
Soldiers use their weight to drive the projectile into the barrel.
The ramming team works in unison to seat the heavy round.
The long ramrod is pushed deep into the breech of the gun.
The ramrod is successfully withdrawn, ready for the charge.
